exposure: severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection
cohort: 40 COVID-19 positive pregnant women admitted to 'Alexandra' maternity hospital between March and December 2020
finding: The course of COVID-19 during pregnancy was predominantly mild, and neonatal outcomes were favorable with no transmission of SARS-CoV-2 observed.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was performed in 57.1% of the cases.
